shortDescription: Manage Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) DLP Notification Templates

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: attach_content
options.description: If set to true, the content that triggered the violation is attached to the DLP notification email.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: html_message
options.description: The template for the HTML message body that is displayed in the DLP notification email.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier for the DLP notification template. Required if updating or deleting a template.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the DLP notification template.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: plain_text_message
options.description: The template for the plain text UTF-8 message body that is displayed in the DLP notification email.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: subject
options.description: The subject line that is displayed within the DLP notification email.

options.name: tls_enabled
options.description: If set to true, enables TLS for the DLP notification template.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.
